schema.text: What would improve this place most?

options.text: Longer green light for people crossing
A new or repaired traffic light
A zebra crossing where it is missing
Sound signal at the traffic light for people who cannot see
More visible signs or markings (where they already exist)
Protect the crossing and curb ramp from parking (for example with bollards)
Better lighting
Better visibility
Safer space to wait or rest
Curb ramps, ramps or working elevators
Reopen closed stairs or passages
Changes that make vehicles go slower
Better maintenance or cleaning
Connect the cycle path from one side of the crossing to the other
Nothing important

it.#What would improve this place most?: Cosa migliorerebbe di più questo luogo?
it.#Longer green light for people crossing: Verde più lungo per chi attraversa
it.#Sound signal at the traffic light for p: Segnale sonoro al semaforo per chi non vede
it.#More visible signs or markings (where t: Segnali o strisce più visibili (dove già ci sono)
it.#Protect the crossing and curb ramp from: Proteggere strisce e scivolo dalla sosta (per esempio con dissuasori)

fr.#What would improve this place most?: Qu'est-ce qui améliorerait le plus ce lieu ?
fr.#Longer green light for people crossing: Un feu vert plus long pour les piétons qui traversent
fr.#A zebra crossing where it is missing: Un passage piéton là où il manque
fr.#Sound signal at the traffic light for p: Signal sonore au feu pour les personnes qui ne voient pas
fr.#More visible signs or markings (where t: Panneaux ou marquages plus visibles (là où ils existent déjà)
fr.#Protect the crossing and curb ramp from: Protéger le passage et le bateau de trottoir du stationnement (par exemple avec des potelets)
fr.#Safer space to wait or rest: Espace plus sûr pour attendre ou se reposer
fr.#Curb ramps, ramps or working elevators: Des bateaux de trottoir, des rampes ou des ascenseurs en état de marche
fr.#Reopen closed stairs or passages: Rouvrir les escaliers ou passages fermés
fr.#Changes that make vehicles go slower: Aménagements pour faire ralentir les véhicules
fr.#Connect the cycle path from one side of: Relier la piste cyclable d'un côté à l'autre du passage

de.#What would improve this place most?: Was würde diesen Ort am meisten verbessern?
de.#Sound signal at the traffic light for p: Tonsignal an der Ampel für Menschen, die nicht sehen können
de.#More visible signs or markings (where t: Besser sichtbare Schilder oder Markierungen (wo es sie schon gibt)
de.#Protect the crossing and curb ramp from: Übergang und abgesenkten Bordstein vor Falschparkern schützen (zum Beispiel mit Pollern)
de.#Safer space to wait or rest: Sichererer Platz zum Warten oder Ausruhen
de.#Curb ramps, ramps or working elevators: Abgesenkte Bordsteine, Rampen oder funktionierende Aufzüge
de.#Reopen closed stairs or passages: Geschlossene Treppen oder Durchgänge wieder öffnen
de.#Connect the cycle path from one side of: Den Radweg von einer Seite des Übergangs zur anderen verbinden

tr.#What would improve this place most?: Bu yeri en çok ne iyileştirir?

tr.#A new or repaired traffic light: Yeni veya onarılmış bir trafik ışığı
tr.#Sound signal at the traffic light for p: Göremeyen kişiler için trafik ışığında sesli sinyal
tr.#More visible signs or markings (where t: Daha görünür işaretler veya çizgiler (zaten olan yerlerde)
tr.#Protect the crossing and curb ramp from: Geçidi ve bordür rampasını park etmeye karşı korumak (örneğin babalarla)
tr.#Safer space to wait or rest: Beklemek veya dinlenmek için daha güvenli alan
tr.#Curb ramps, ramps or working elevators: Bordür rampaları, rampalar veya çalışan asansörler
tr.#Reopen closed stairs or passages: Kapalı merdivenleri veya geçitleri yeniden açmak
tr.#Connect the cycle path from one side of: Bisiklet yolunu geçidin bir yanından diğerine bağlamak

fa.#Safer space to wait or rest: فضای امن‌تر برای انتظار یا استراحت
fa.#Curb ramps, ramps or working elevators: رمپ لبه پیاده‌رو، رمپ یا آسانسورهای فعال
fa.#Changes that make vehicles go slower: تغییراتی که سرعت خودروها را کم کند
fa.#Connect the cycle path from one side of: وصل مسیر دوچرخه از یک سوی گذرگاه به سوی دیگر

hu.#What would improve this place most?: Mi javítana a legtöbbet ezen a helyen?
hu.#Sound signal at the traffic light for p: Hangjelzés a jelzőlámpán azoknak, akik nem látnak
hu.#More visible signs or markings (where t: Jobban látható táblák vagy burkolati jelek (ahol már vannak)

hu.#Reopen closed stairs or passages: A lezárt lépcsők vagy átjárók újranyitása
hu.#Changes that make vehicles go slower: Átalakítások, hogy a járművek lassabban haladjanak
hu.#Connect the cycle path from one side of: A kerékpárút összekötése az átkelő egyik oldalától a másikig

ar.#Safer space to wait or rest: مساحة أكثر أمانًا للانتظار أو الاستراحة
ar.#Curb ramps, ramps or working elevators: منحدرات عند حافة الرصيف أو منحدرات أو مصاعد تعمل
